title: SURGICAL, CHEAP, AND FLEXIBLE: MITIGATING FALSE REFUSAL IN LANGUAGE MODELS VIA SINGLE VECTOR ABLATION
reasoning: The paper focuses on mitigating false refusal while maintaining safety (harmlessness), which is a core component of AI ethics and alignment. It uses safety benchmarks to evaluate the model's adherence to ethical guidelines and its ability to handle sensitive prompts, including those related to discrimination and illegal activities.
